[*] Adjusted the behavior of the Back button when using a controller in the Shop to ease navigation
[*] Loot Chests have their own category in the Cosmetics section of the Shop
[*] General readability and sorting improvements in the Shop
[*] Adjusted the location of the Seed # in Survival mode to match the HUD better
[*] Pets use a ‘jump down’ animation when following you from a cliff/edge/slope
[/list][/list]
As always, don’t hesitate to let us know of any feedback or issues you encounter - enjoy the Witch Saga!

Seil seil,
The Norsfell team

tags.feature: - The fabled Norse Realm of the dead has been added as a whole new biome for you to explore!
- Where there is Helheim, there is Hel. The notorious ruler of the dead has made her calculated appearance, and surely she’s up to no good.
- Hel has taken the fallen god Baldr prisoner for her dark plans, and it is up to the Einherjar to brave the depths of Niflheim itself to get him back!
- The Witch Saga debuts the ability for players to farm Ingredients of their choosing by digging holes with the new Shovel tool, planting Essences, then waiting for the crop to grow.
- The Witch Saga also debuts the ability for Tribes of Midgard players to connect together online between Steam, Epic Games Store and Xbox Live!
- Players can search for players across other platforms from the Cross-Network Search tab of the Invite menu. You can also review recently met players, add Friends and review pending Friend Requests.
- Cross-network play is enabled by default, but can be deactivated from the Settings menu if you only want to play with players on your current platform.
- Players have an icon to represent their platform located next to their player name in the lobby and in-game player lists.
- Learning from the Jötnar, defeated Ancients will now respawn after a while, coming back stronger each time.
- Starter Kits are now no longer exclusive to Saga Mode. Mix and match to create unique play styles as you start up your new Survival World!
- Dagný can now be upgraded with Souls like any other Villager. As she levels up her healing ability is improved, as well as her combat capabilities during a night defense.
- We’ve added the ability to now drop Runes from the Inventory, allowing players to share them amongst each other and facilitate combining effects.
- New Sub-Tabs were added to the War/Storage Chests to accommodate this.
- A new discoverable in-game challenge is available for all new Survival Worlds - the Saplings.
- Players can find Saplings, nascent Seeds of Yggdrasil, as they explore Midgard.
- Planted Essences around a Sapling will grow at an increased rate.
- However, just like the Seed of Yggdrasil in the Village, the magic of these trees is sure to bring danger.

- You can trigger an invasion event at a Sapling, in which hordes of enemies will attempt to destroy it. Build defenses and fight well! If the Sapling survives the enemy wave, you’ll earn rewards and you even be able to upgrade the Sapling itself.
- Upgraded Saplings will increase the rate at which your Essences grow.
- There is one Sapling per Biome, and each will come under attack by different types of enemies - find and defend them all!
All Meals, new and old, now have the chance to trigger a secondary effect upon consumption.
- Provides an aura of Mana generation around you for a time. Chance to summon Unsunken allies when consuming.
- Provides an aura of Speed boost around you for a time. Chance to trigger a Heal in a radius around you when consuming.
- Grant increased Armor for a time. Chance to trigger an aura of ice shield around you when consuming.
- Provides an aura of Health regeneration around you for a time. Chance to trigger a secondary field of healing around you when consuming.
- Provides an aura of bonus Damage around you for a time. Chance to trigger a trail of fire in your wake when consuming.
- Spell 1 - Flurry: Rapid series of Spear thrusts at your target
- Spell 2 - Whirlwind Dash: Dash forward, leaving a damaging field behind you
- Spell 1 - Whirlwind: Spin your Sword around you, dealing Cold damage
- Spell 2 - Trail Strike: Summon a lane of frost, dealing initial damage as well as leaving a damaging field for a short time
- Spell 1 - Spin: Spin your Spear around you, dealing Cold damage in an area over time
- Spell 2 - Shock Dash: Dash forward, then release a powerful wave of Cold damage in front of you
- Armor Perk - Fallen Up: Deal extra damage to Fallen foes, like Unsunken, Unfrozen, and the new Draugr
- Spell 1 - Death Orb: Fire a slow-moving Dark projectile that explodes on impact
- Spell 2 - Shadow Dash: Dash forward, dealing damage and leeching health from enemies you hit. Also leaves a damaging trail in its wake.
- Spell 3 - Crackling Doom: Fire three deadly projectiles that each leave a damaging trail in their wake.
- Armor Perk - Leech: A chance to regenerate a percentage of the damage done when you strike a foe.
- Charging Time [Common]
- Nordic Spa [Uncommon]
- Walking Furnace [Uncommon]
- Walking Fridge [Uncommon]
- Top Týr [Rare]
- Iðunn Care [Rare]
- Helthing Slayer [Rare]
- Shovel Warfare [Rare]
- Riposte Finale [Epic]
- Hel Rune [Legendary]
- Extreme Conditions Starter Kit [Uncommon]
- Mastery & Embrace Starter Kit [Rare]
- Meal Maker Starter Kit [Epic]
- Allfarmer Starter Kit [Epic]
- Party Viking Starter Kit [Legendary]
- Expedition Starter Kit has been updated to become the Ancient Expedition Starter Kit, now including Treasure Maps to the Bridge, a Beacon, an Outpost, and an Undergate.
- Dubbed the Vilespitter, this Jormie comes with a new look and new attacks that emphasize his notoriously potent poison.
- It is a random chance as to which Jörmungandr you’ll face, so be prepared for anything.

- With Vilespitter emphasizing Jörmungandr’s love of poison, we went back to the original Jörmungandr and made some adjustments to his moveset, especially by improving his Tail Slam, to lean into his status as a proper destroyer of worlds (and bones)!

- These fallen warriors lost their chance to be Einherjar and instead serve Hel as her formidable army. Draugr wield lengthy spears and powerful Ice magic that can slow your advance (or escape), making them deadly in groups.

- Niflheim is the home of the Helthings; where the most powerful of their kind reside. And none more so than the Guardling, an immensely tough brute who will use its massive arms to pummel any unfortunate Einherjar looking to make their way through Niflheim.
- These one-way Caves can be found across the Bright Forest and serve as dens for a myriad of Creatures.
- Descend into the dangerous Caves and claim the treasures that surely lay within.
- We’ve made a couple more layouts that are randomly generated when entering an Underpass on your way to the Desert
- Each Underpass layout now has an Elite Creature, so tread carefully - you got this!
- Quest Boards can now be built as a new Station from the Allforge in Survival Mode after defeating Járnsaxa, allowing players to select and complete Personal Quests for Artifacts and other rewards.
- We’ve added 4 unique Stations that allow players to edit their character customization options in game.
- These Stations can be built from the Decorations tab of the Allforge in Survival Mode, and are located in the Longhouse when in Saga Mode
- Character Mirror: Modify your Character Customization options (Face, Hair, Body, etc.)
- Accessory Hut: Modify your equipped Accessories (Pets and Loot Chests)
- Weapon Collection: Modify your equipped Weapon Cosmetic options
- Protection Mannequin: Modify your equipped Protection Cosmetic options

- Picking up resources by hand is tough work, but we’ve got just the thing! Now players can craft Sickles to help in harvesting ground Materials like Plants, Branches and Flint. Sickles behave just like Lumberaxes and Pickaxes - the higher rarity the Tool, the better the yield!
- Sickles can be built alongside other Tools at the Tool Grinder in Survival Mode, or from the Tinker in Saga Mode.
- A new Legendary Potion made its way to the Sorcerers - with the magical ability to instantly refund all of your Blessing Points from that World!
- Purchased for a small amount of Golden Horns at any Sorcerer
- Vegetables have been added, and they’re unique Materials in that they cannot be found naturally out in the wild - they must be grown.
- Find their Essences and plant them in a hole dug with your new trusty Shovel to harvest them.
- Vegetables can be used to craft new Recipes, including powerful Legendary Meals (see Content section below). New Vegetables:
- We've implemented Facial Hair as its own Customization option separate from Hairstyles or Faces!
- A new Facial Hair subtab is now available in the Characters Sub-Menu of the Customize tab.
- Facial Hair can be applied regardless of Body Type, and its color is tied with the Hair Dye selection.
- [b]Poison Ballista:[/b] Players can also build a Poison Turret that will fire bolts in a straight line.
- [b]Flame Turret:[/b] Players can now build a Flame Turret that will spew flames at oncoming enemies.
- Both of these are built from the Defense Workshop Station
- [b]Thatch/Wooden/Slate Invert Roof:[/b] Opposite of the Corner Roof constructions that are ideal for outside, these Invert Roof pieces are great for sealing interior corners.
- [b]Hymir’s Pot:[/b] New Legendary Construction earned for turning in the Hel Trophy at Eira. When full, you can activate it to receive a large boost to damage for 5 minutes.
- [b]Shield Mount:[/b] New decorative construction that allows you to mount a Shield on a Wall and customize which Shield you want to display
- [b]Blades of Hel:[/b] New decorative construction to showcase your epic victory over Hel. Earned by defeating Hel in Survival Mode.
- Decorations are built from the Decorations tab in the Allforge
- The Witch Saga comes with another Free Season Track of 49 levels to achieve and rewards to unlock, including new Recipes, Portraits, Equipment, Platinum Coins, Starter Kits and more!
- Hel’s Bane: Defeat Hel in Survival Mode
- Ultimate Bane x8: Defeat each Jötunn and each Ancient in their final Level 10 form in Survival Mode to earn their Portraits. Collect them all!
- Ancient: Quadruple Kill: Defeat 4 Ancients in a single World in Saga Mode
- Bonebreaker Part 1/2/3: Defeat Bonebreaker Jörmungandr in 14/10/8 Days in Saga Mode
- Vilespitter Part 1/2/3: Defeat Vilespitter Jörmungandr in 14/10/8 Days in Saga Mode
- Witch Saga Part 1/2/3: Defeat Hel 1/5/10 times in Saga Mode
- Helkyrie Set: Armor x5 and Equipment x6
- Draugr Set: Armor x5 and Equipment x6
- Móðguðr Set: Armor x5 and Equipment x6
- Hella Stella - The only creature in the Nine Realms bold enough to simply walk into Helheim.
- Garmr Pup - The fierce guard dog of Hel’s gates, or at least he was supposed to be…
- Queen Hel - Behold your dark Queen in all of her glory!
- Niflheim Loot Chest
- Hel Loot Chest
- Draugr Portrait
- Squirrel Portrait
- Guardling Portrait
- Móðguðr Portrait

tags.balance_change: - The location + Rarities of several Crafting Stations have been moved from their original dependencies to ease navigation/discoverability. Affected stations:
- Ammunition Shelf moved to the Allforge from the Weapon Furnace
- Potion Brewer moved to the Allforge from the Meal Cauldron. Rarity changed to Epic.
- Defense Workshop moved to the Allforge from the Weapon Furnace. Rarity changed to Epic.
- Artifact Altar moved to the Allforge from the Mining Stand. Rarity changed to Epic.
- Tanning and Mining Stands moved to the Allforge from the Lumbering Stand. Rarities changed to Rare, max out Level now at 2
- This will allow players easier access to these refining stations and help transmute the much-needed Yarn in the early game as well.
- Boat Dock now requires Ancient Cores instead of Járnsaxa Materials.
- This will allow players to never be stranded for too long on a beach
- Jarnsaxa Loot modified to reflect this
- Costs to assemble Fragments from the Artifact Altar have risen.

- Crafting Fragments serves as a shortcut/alternative route for those with the resources to spare, so with the ability to get all Fragments in a Survival World from completing objectives (+ now the Quest Board Station), we wanted to balance the Pros/Cons of these avenues.
- Jotnar and Ancients will now cap at Level 10 in Survival Mode
- In Survival and Saga, Sanctuary is now considered a Temperature Safe Zone, in which you are protected from both Hot or Cold effects.
- In Survival, an activated Portal Shrine will now also act as a Temp Safe Zone
- Personal Quests with Merchant Map as Reward replaced by Outpost Map
- Personal Quests with Shrine Map as Reward replaced by Sorcerer Map
- Survival Mode: Jötunn Level Multiplier increased 1.5 from 1.2
- Survival Mode: previously invincible constructions now have large HP pools instead
- Decorations based off of defeated Ancients now require their respective Trophy drop to build. Take advantage of the Ancient Respawning for multiple decorations!
- Jörmungandr and Surtr received Elemental Weaknesses and Strengths to their Armor Resistance

- Our goal with these Rune changes is to provide more variety when it comes to high-damage builds. By strengthening many undertuned Runes, we hope that the end-result will provide a lot more build flexibility when tackling all stages of a World. We took a look at some of the Runes we’ve had since launch, as the game has changed drastically since then, and evaluated if their current values still make sense given the latest changes.
- Harvest Boom range increased from 250 to 350 radius
- Might of Mjölnir increased from 300 to 400 damage
- Explosive Finale increased from 400 to 500 damage
- Winters Wake increased from 200 damage to 300 damage
- Making Waves increased from 300 damage to 600 damage
- Ire of Oðinn increased from 10% to 15% damage
- Ire of Thór increased from 10% to 15% damage
- Arm of Ullr increased from 20% to 30% damage
- Far Fetched increased from 20% to 30% damage
- Buffing both Arm of Ullr and Far Fetched should help Bow builds stand out a little more when it comes to damage at all stages of the game.
- Soul Keeper reduced from 25% to 15% Souls kept

- A recent change was that players now only lose a percentage of their Souls upon death by default, making the Soul Keeper Rune much more valuable. We slightly reduced the number of Souls kept so that it didn’t mean that a single Common Rune could negate all Souls lost.
- Soul Powered reduced from 5 to 2 damage per 100 Souls

- The risk/reward playstyle of Soul Powered turned out to be much more reward than risk as the game received additional updates. We still enjoy the Soul-hoarding loop of empowering a Soul Powered Rune, but a flat 500 damage bonus per Rune at 10,000 Souls became both too easy to maintain, and far too powerful for a single Rune slot, to the point that it was invalidating a lot of other build options. To increase our goal of build flexibility, we have reduced the maximum damage to 200 from 500, which still grants it the single highest flat damage bonus per Rune slot, but now it fits much better with other Runes on your belt, and would require additional stacking to get to the levels that it was previously providing, rather than just needing a single Rune.
- Pumped Up increased from 25% to 35% damage
- With powerful foes and poison attacks now able to chip away at your Mana, it’s become more difficult to maintain a full gauge to benefit from Pumped Up, so we increased the power to compensate.
- With this latest round of Class and Blessing balance updates, our goal was to increase build flexibility as well as hone in further on each class’s strengths and gameplay niche.
- All Classes Weapon Mastery increased to 20% damage from 10%
- Warrior Underdog range increased to 4 meters from 3 meters
- Warrior Underdog damage increased to 40 per enemy from 20
- Warrior Final Act chance increased to 75% from 50%
- Ranger Ullr Step II Damage increased to 400 from 300
- Guardian Ironclad I increased to 25% HP from 20%
- Guardian Ironclad II increased to 50% HP from 40%
- Guardian Pain Release II duration increased to 20 seconds from 5 seconds

- We wanted Guardian to not only feel like a tanky character, but one that specializes in counter-attacking. Pain Release is a great ability that allows Guardians to unleash a flurry of fast hitting attacks after an AoE wave of cold and stun, but we felt the speed bonus was too short, making it difficult to enjoy the effects. The increased duration should make it much easier to travel from fight to fight and maintain the powerful buff.
- Seer Tempered Aura range increased to 5 meters from 3 meters
- Berserker Infernal Rage damage increased to 50% from 25%
- Berserker Critical Hit I chance increased to 30% from 25%
- Berserker Critical Hit II chance increased to 60% from 50%
- Hunter Decoy Archer damage increased to 500 from 300
- Hunter Decoy Wolf melee damage increased to 500 from 300
- Hunter Decoy Wolf leap damage increased to 1000 from 600

- Decoys are unique to the Hunter, but their low damage made them less impactful as the game went on. With a flat buff to all of their damage values, they become a force to be reckoned with in early game and have much stronger staying power as the game goes on.

tags.bug: - Storage Chests in Survival Mode can no longer be dismantled so long as there are Items remaining in their Inventory. This should help prevent accidental loss of precious loot.
- You can now view Chat Log history by scrolling up on the in-game chat window
- Time stamps added to chat entries as well as announcements
- Players can now view the profile of other players from this screen, and add them as Friends.
- Construction height limit increased to 9 from 5
- Grid height now adjusts as player adjusts their own height
- When in Build Mode, we’ve added an input to change the shape of the Deconstruction Cube, to give a better degree of control over what you want to dismantle and where

- The see-through effect when obstructed by your Constructions has been fully revamped. You can now toggle a transparency effect from the Build Menu on and off if you need added visibility. This combined effort should make it easier to build your dream home just the way you like it!
- While Build Mode is maintained, opening the Build Menu will now open the last Construction tab you were viewing.
- PC - adjusted the default key bindings for some Construction Mode inputs
- Dismantle is now assigned to [F]
- Grid Up/Down is now assigned to the Mouse Wheel
- These were all guided by feedback from the community and we’ll keep on improving the construction system in future updates. 💙
- Now after placing a Construction, an Undo prompt will be available. Pressing the Undo button will immediately disassemble the Construction and refund it
- When in Build Mode, the rarity of the Construction you’re about to place will now be reflected on the HUD
- When rotating the Camera from Build Mode, the Mini-Map will correctly re-orient and reflect the player’s position and direction faced
- When dismantling or undoing a Construction piece, you’ll now receive the Construction piece as a loot drop, rather than the Materials required to build it.

- Rather than showing a health bar for each Construction when it takes damage, we’ve added a visual effect to show degradation when a piece is damaged. You can still view the health bars when in Build mode.

- Digging holes with your Shovel or placing a Construction piece over grass, a bush, or a resource node (like a tree) will remove that object. Further, enemies will no longer spawn on top, or inside of a Construction piece if one was placed near a spawn point.
- Survival Mode players can now:
- View the World name
- Toggle revealing the World password, if private
- Saga Mode players can now:
- Trigger a Vote to Kick or Ban a target player
- View the World name
- Rewards from the Season Track are no longer claimed automatically upon advancing Season Level. Players now need to claim them from the Rewards menu, harmonizing the behavior of other rewards.
- Once you’ve acquired enough Mana to fill a full segment, that amount is now protected and won’t deplete beyond that section when struck by a powerful foe.

- As the revamped Survival Mode presents a more play-your-own-way approach to completing Saga Quests, we subtitled it as Story Mode to better communicate this. Due to the reduced pressures of Survival, we’ve also put it first on the list of modes to highlight it as an entry point into learning how to play Tribes of Midgard.

- As Tribes of Midgard has continued to add content in the year since launch, Saga Mode has really become a haven for those who appreciate the time pressure and the challenges that an impending Fimbulwinter brings. Due to this, we subtitled Saga Mode as Last Stand to better communicate the hardcore, roguelite nature.
- Sorcerers and Merchants get their own Maps now, and are no longer combined into a single Treasure Map (which would reveal one or the other).
- Sóleyra & Mániklo’s tutorial dialogue will now prompt in Saga Mode as well to help guide players through its systems.
- Similar to new Loading Tips, we’ve added a number of new Cat Tutorials centered on new content as well as systems we felt could’ve been better elaborated.
- Cat Tutorials can be disabled from the Settings.
- Delving into Hideouts are now easier to navigate, thanks to some handy signage that points towards the exit on each floor.
- Vibration setting is now on a scale of intensity instead of On/Off
- Added an option to toggle the Autoequip behavior of new/repaired Equipment On/Off (great for those Nothing to Hide/Wield builds!) 💙
- You will now no longer be kicked for Idling for a long time when playing Solo Survival or Solo Saga
- Fishing spots will no longer be destroyed when the fishing sequence was interrupted by damage
- Souls, Season XP and Construction pieces are now included in what your trusty Pet will automatically loot for you.
- Adjusting Body Type in the Customize menu is no longer a toggle, but a standard selection
- Passwords are now displayed as you type them when attempting to access a private Survival World
- In-game announcements are now played to indicate the start of Summer / Winter seasons in Survival. An announcement will also play in Saga to inform when Fimbulwinter will begin.
- Outside of the standard saves, a routine autosave will now occur in the World every 7 minutes, down from 10.
- You can now Toggle Realm in the Map screen to shift between Midgard and Niflheim
- Altered the order of tabs in Allforge/Stations in Survival to better prioritize content
- When starting a new Survival World, Recipes for the Tool Grinder, Weapon Furnace and Armor Loom are auto-pinned to ease up tracking (can un-pin from the Recipe tab)
- Added icons to highlight Cosmetic items that were a part of a Festive Event
- Adjusted the behavior of the Back button when using a controller in the Shop to ease navigation
- Loot Chests have their own category in the Cosmetics section of the Shop
- General readability and sorting improvements in the Shop
- Adjusted the location of the Seed # in Survival mode to match the HUD better
- Pets use a ‘jump down’ animation when following you from a cliff/edge/slope

notes.title: Tribes of Midgard: Our Next Major Update - Dev Blog #5
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=H9RFJXux3Fs;full][/previewyoutube]
Hiló Vikings,

Today we’re very excited to be bringing Dev Blog #5, and to talk with you about what's coming next for Tribes of Midgard, including some sneak peeks for our next major update in 2023! ☃️ You can check out the full video above! :) Here's the recap:

[h2]2022 IN A NUTSHELL[/h2]

We welcomed many new Einherjar by launching on both Xbox and Nintendo Switch this year, meaning that Tribes of Midgard is now available just about everywhere. 

As always, we want to thank our beloved community (that's you). We've been looking closely into all of your feedback and accomplishments in the game - like this 30 minute speedrun (wow)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/6b5e48162e00e29ec4860015c3e21eba2be88cb2.jpg[/img]

This year, our [url=https://www.tribesofmidgard.com/midguardians/]Midguardians Community Program[/url] also reached over 12,000 members, with over 30,000 rewards redeemed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/12c057844493fcf6a79858167ed800d6a6140674.jpg[/img]

We celebrated our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/858820/announcements/detail/3383912359091449778]first anniversary[/url] together, and released our biggest update by far - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/858820/announcements/detail/3409807423282124439]the Inferno Saga[/url], with its entirely rebuilt Survival Mode, among many other additions. We also had 2 returning events: Valhalloween and Yulidays.

Our new studio is finally furnished, and our team of 41 is now enjoying the benefits of fully flexible working from here or home. What a year! And we aren't stopping anytime soon - let's get into what's coming next.

[h1]OUR NEXT MAJOR UPDATE[/h1]

We’ll say it here first - 2023 will start off with a new, free, major Saga update to Tribes of Midgard! A new Saga means a new Ancient, and new content, but also, plenty of surprises across both Game Modes.

Here are a few sneak peeks for you.

[h2]FARMING [/h2]

What is Viking life without a little farming? With your [b]new Shovel[/b], you’ll be able to plant Essences anywhere in Midgard, and then reap the benefits of your bountiful harvest. That includes growing Vegetables used for new Meals, but also Garnet and Iron. It’s magic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/21b3d138d29b642a258e23a7acdc0a11b17ffc26.gif[/img]

[h2]SAPLINGS[/h2]

In Survival, players will now be able to find a [b]Sapling[/b] per biome, offshoots of Yggdrasil where bases can be built around to benefit from its aura. But, it also triggers enemy attacks to put your defenses to the challenge and earn extra rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/88717b848f934f53d0d667043ad1f7c0c379ecd6.gif[/img]

[h2]CONSTRUCTIONS[/h2]

Last October, we increased the Construction amount limit based on your feedback. We've now also increased the building height limit from [b]5 storeys to 9[/b], so you can build your very own 3-story Treehouse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/de085212db4114f6975308b15aaf3b8be9218ccf.gif[/img]

And this is just one of the dozens of improvements brought to Construction Mode, with others including a handy "undo" button, see-through effects to choose from and landscaping to remove unwanted resources after placing a piece.

[h2]ANCIENTS NOW RESPAWN IN SURVIVAL MODE[/h2]

Yup. And they level up!

[h1]QUALITY OF LIFE[/h1]

Our next update will bring over 30 Quality of Life improvements, and most of them are inspired directly from our community. Let me list off just a couple…
[list]
[*] A brand new potion, [b]Mimir's Water,[/b] allows you to reset your Class and Blessings. Get that theory crafting going, speedrunners!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/b74c7323a7bd227413af9bc51dbb8e7f28b559ac.gif[/img]

[*] Challenges can now be tracked and redeemed [b]in-game[/b]. No need to return to the Main Menu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/1b867d57cfd4de1a416e0339138b56e64ab93ab6.gif[/img]

[*] Cosmetics constructions allow you to swap your best costumes and bring your cutest pets along! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/40e6446faa67eb1173565385940e0e489a8bb28c.gif[/img]

[*] Moderation options were added to allow kicking players, but also to trigger votes in Saga Mode to encourage fair play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/3937e03a8a3bf10a8f1d71e4fc7def5dfc5620ff.gif[/img]

[*] Last but not least, Chat history is now available with time stamps!
[/list]
This is just a taste of what's to come in 2023. [i]Who knows, you might even get to explore a new biome and sport your favorite beards very soon![/i] In the meantime, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858820/view/5025482135639589122]enjoy our Yulidays Festive Event[/url] before your Worlds are reset early next year to make room for our next major update! Be sure to follow us on our socials for all other information.

Thanks for your support, stay toasty, happy holidays from all of us at Norsfell, and we’ll see you in the New Year! 👋

Seil Seil!

Discord: https://discord.gg/tribesofmidgard
Twitter: https://twitter.com/tribesofmidgard
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/tribesofmidgard/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tribesofmidgard/
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/tribesofmidgard
Website: https://www.tribesofmidgard.com/

notes.title: The Yulidays Festive Event - December 13th to January 2nd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/913f5742f3c8479fea591b71e81d14fc8288379b.png[/img]

HilóHoHo Vikings,

‘Tis the season! It's time to kick off our second edition of Yulidays, our in-game Festive Event running from [b]December 13th to January 2nd.[/b]

Valhalla, the Sanctuary, the Village, and even the Goblins (er… Snoblins) will be showing off their festive spirit. The Yulidays themed Main Menu and musical track also make their return! So gather around the hearth, and unlock unique rewards with this year’s Festive Challenges! 

We'd like to preface this patch by emphasizing this is a returning event from last year, with some new additions, to celebrate the holiday season together. In the meantime, [b]our main focus[/b] has been working on our next big update... more on that below. 👀

With that said, let’s get into our last patch notes of the year.

[h3][b]Festive Challenges: [/b][/h3]
During the Yulidays Event from December 13th to January 2nd, there will be 3 Festive Challenges that can only be completed during this limited time event.

Complete these challenges to earn unique Yulidays Content:
[list]
[*] [b]Challenge #1:[/b] December 13 - December 19: Defeat Enemies: Yulálfar x50
[list][*] Reward: Yuledrasil Portrait[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/e5524719425a0b442c4a4d7284814efca69f6786.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Challenge #2:[/b] December 20 - December 26: Defeat Enemies: Unfrozen x20
[list][*] Reward: Yuledeer Pet[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/219411645ea5f3157324c9f2d524e04dcf3050dd.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Challenge #3:[/b] December 27 - January 2nd: Defeat Enemies: Snoblins x80
[list][*] Reward: Yuledeer Portrait[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/333ee43804f701acd32f8f1aaf19e151cab413cc.gif[/img]

[h3][b]New Cosmetic Sets Debuting with the Yulidays Update:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Yuledrasil Set:[/b] Armor x5 and Equipment x6
[i][list][*] Unlocked with Platinum Coins in the Shop[/list][/i][*] [b]Sóleyra Costume:[/b] Armor x5 and Shield
[i][list][*] Unlocked with Golden Horns in the Shop[/list][/i][*] [b]Mániklo Costume:[/b] Armor x5 and Shield
[i][list][*] Unlocked with Golden Horns in the Shop[/list][/i]
[/list]Last year’s Yulidays Cosmetics make their return in the Shop for Golden Horns:[list][*] [b]Allfather Set: [/b]Armor x5 and Equipment x6
[i][list][*] Unlocked with Golden Horns the Shop[/list][/i][*] [b]Bucky the Yule Goat:[/b]  Oft-forgotten and stuck on the sidelines, this year’s holiday event marks Bucky the Yule Goat’s time to shine (again)!
[i][list][*] Unlocked with Golden Horns the Shop[/list][/i][*] [b]Yule Portrait[/b]
[i][list][*] Unlocked with Golden Horns the Shop[/list][/i]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/60ec2f6d188d589a9cbb89fdd30194585813b180.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New Pet Debuting with Yulidays Update:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Yuledeer:[/b] Descended from the great Stags of Yggdrasil, this little guy just wants to prance around the great tree and hang festive decorations. His holiday spirit is infectious.
[i][list][*] Unlocked via Festive Challenge #2[/list][/i]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/9a9c856df28fd7d7d9512c935e6abb18ad430308.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Yulidays SHiFT Codes: Mániklo and Sóleyra Shields[/b] [/h3]
Did you know? The goddess Freyja was so enamored with her immortal feline companions that she would often dress her children up in costumes of them, even after they became full-grown adults. It’s a totally true story. 

It turns out, she also bestowed two SHiFT codes upon the land of Midgard especially for you this Yulidays season! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/45f2dfd969cc5fcb21233498d7c033b14da63350.gif[/img]

[b]How to Redeem:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Link Tribes of Midgard account to your SHiFT account
[olist][*] Head to the “Settings” tab located in game, then to the “SHiFT” tab
[*] Copy the code found in game to the SHiFT website: [url=https://shift.gearboxsoftware.com/]https://shift.gearboxsoftware.com/[/url][/olist]
[*] Head to the “Rewards” tab on the website
[*] Redeem code: 
[list][*]KCRB3-F6CTB-H9S35-33JBT-XCFBT (Sóleyra)
[*]W5RJB-CFWJ3-ZHZ35-J3J3J-FRHZF (Mániklo)[/list]
[/olist]
We want to see you rocking your matching Shields - take a photo with your fellow Vikings, and be sure to tag us!

[h3][b]Yulidays Allfather Yule Discount[/b][/h3]
We’ll be running a 30% discount on the Allfather Yule Set during the Event! Swing on over to the Shop to gear up in cozy mittens and a glorious cape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/307f37338faaeba9e7d3b155a732c83fd01d2559.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Yule Log Fire + Community Streams[/b][/h3]
Come gather by the Yule Log this holiday season, get cozy, and listen to the Tribes of Midgard soundtrack over [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H50ykmBzfUw]on our YouTube channel here[/url]. And speaking of gathering - be sure to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/tribesofmidgard]follow us over on Twitch[/url], as we’ll be streaming and holding some exciting giveaways! 

[h3][b]What’s Coming in 2023?[/b][/h3]
We’re so excited to share more of the new content and features you can expect to see… very soon (with some teasers this December) including:
[list]
[*] A brand new Ancient to battle (... in a new, never-before-explored location)

Look out for our Dev Blog video dropping later this week! 

As always, our ears and eyes are open and we appreciate your continuous support and feedback. Enjoy the Yulidays, and talk soon!

notes.title: Tribes of Midgard - On Sale for 50% off!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/f6fef4289eb44a266c6460045c1e2db1a1813e35.png[/img]

Hiló Vikings,

In our biggest sale to date, and to celebrate [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858820/view/3288215215597604409]the spooky Valhalloween season[/url], Tribes of Midgard is now 50% off from October 18th to November 1st!

[h2]Valhalloween Festive Event - Ongoing[/h2]

Our Valhalloween Festive Event is currently ongoing - it comes with an increase to the Construction limit, quality of life improvements, 3 Festive Challenges and more. Here's a quick recap of what rolled in with the patch:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/c2b4c6ab9206b00710ac8f2029557f5290cf3179.png[/img] 

And since our Week 2 Challenge is currently ongoing, here's what that Frog Prince Pet looks like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/8664a49e13541e4ad8dc0ea088042596adbeceac.jpg[/img]

[h2]Guides[/h2]

If you're hopping in for the first time (welcome, Viking!) we have some pretty great guides created by our community! You can check those out here:
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ROkimg-_6WU]Triple G’s Complete Guide to Survival[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PDGByLfHOUY]A Powerpoint Guide to Surtr[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WoMU5k-qUBE]Jade PG Guide to Summer and Winter in Survival Mode[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.tribesofmidgard.com/index.php?threads/10-tips-and-tricks-to-playing-tribes-of-midgard.1135/]10 Tips and Tricks to Playing Tribes of Midgard[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.tribesofmidgard.com/index.php?threads/the-sundial-world-clock-in-tribes-of-midgard-explained.1195/]The World Clock Explained[/url]
[/list]We're always on the lookout for more, so don't hesitate to drop by our Discord if you have some tips to share!

[h2]Reporting Issues[/h2]

If you’re experiencing any bugs or issues, we're here to help! Please be sure to either head to our [url=https://discord.gg/tribesofmidgard]Discord[/url] or Forums to receive real-time assistance. You can find the full list of currently known issues [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/858820/discussions/1/3183485686830191859/]here.[/url]

[h2]Reviews[/h2]

Lastly, we wanted to take a moment to openly and honestly speak on our current Steam review score. We've been compiling the top negative review feedback, and noting actionable moves we can take on our part to address these comments, which are entirely valid and constructive. We have always approached development with an open ear to our community.

We have been receiving a high influx of players who are unable to start the game (due to the regional firewalls in Mainland China, and unfortunately, not in our control). We've created a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/858820/discussions/7/]sub-forum here[/url] to help bridge this gap in translation and to hopefully better inform those players.

We hope that, despite the current score, you can enjoy your time in Midgard and become part of our amazing community. We appreciate you, your feedback, and all your kind words!

Got questions about the game? We'll be hanging in the comments!

Talk soon, and seil seil,
The Norsfell Team

notes.title: The Valhalloween Festive Event has begun! (Oct 11th - Nov 1st)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/031e454868fe18f0d61cf2fc659b2187df872bd0.jpg[/img]

Embrace the spooky season! This celebration returns to Midgard today, October 11th, 2022. Everyone and everything from Valhalla, to the Village, to the Goblins (and even some Helthings) will be showing off their seasonal makeovers. The Valhalloween themed main menu and night defense musical tracks will also be making their return! 

Along with the Festive changes, we’ve introduced improvements to the Construction system - quintupling the build limit on PC and doubling the limit on all other platforms. We're still hard at work on this system, and have taken the first steps in a direction to allow for more Constructions in a World, but have plans to improve and optimize it further with our next large update. We are actively monitoring your conversation surrounding the build system and beyond, and appreciate all your feedback!

With that said, let's get this Valhalloween party started.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/c2b4c6ab9206b00710ac8f2029557f5290cf3179.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3][b]Valhalloween Update - QoL Changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Construction Limit Gauge[/b]
[list][*] To help track the Build Limits within a given World, we’ve added a UI element in Survival that tracks the progress as more Constructions are placed, making it easier to recognize when you’re about to hit the cap.[/list][*] [b]Increased Build Limit[/b]
[list][*] We worked hard to optimize the weight of large amounts of Constructions in a single World so that you can build the Viking home you always wanted!
[*] We’re continuing to improve this system and monitor how it handles from a technical standpoint out in the wild, but in the meantime we’ve increased the Build Limits on all platforms as such:[/list][list][list][*] Quintupled the Build Limit on PC
[*] Doubled the Build Limit on all Nintendo Switch as well as all Xbox and PlayStation platforms[/list][/list][*] [b]Storage Chest Sharing[/b]
[list][*] Crafting Stations now have a visual radius when interacting or placing them. This radius indicates that the contents of any Storage Chest located within its bounds can be accessed for the purpose of crafting and does not need to be in the Player’s inventory. This should ease up Players’ ability to readily access Materials from any combination of Storage Chests when crafting from nearby stations.[/list][*] [b]Storage Chest Dismantling[/b]
[list][*] We recognized that it was a little too easy to have your Storage Chests be dismantled while there was still precious cargo inside, losing it forever. To remedy this, we’ve made it so that you cannot dismantle a Storage Chest until all of its contents have been removed, triggering a warning if you try to do so.[/list][*] [b]Center on Shrine[/b]
[list][*] When pressing the Seed of Yggdrasil shortcut on the Map, the cursor now centers on the Shrine instead of the Seed, something very useful to free up fast travel with a controller and a feature requested by the Community.[/list][*] [b]Shop Currency[/b]
[list][*] Currency icons have been added to Shop categories to better inform players at a glance (E.G. Gameplay section has a Golden Horn icon)[/list][*] Loading Screen Progress Bar
[list][*] Loading screens now come equipped with a handy little loading bar to help communicate the progress[/list]
[/list][h3][b]Festive Challenges:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] During the Valhalloween Event from October 11th to November 1st, there will be 3 Festive Challenges that can only be completed during this limited time event. 
[*] Complete these Challenges to earn unique Valhalloween Content
[/list][list]
[*] Challenge #1: October 11 - October 17: DEFEAT PUMPKIN GOBLINS
[*] Reward: Vybyn Portrait
[*] Challenge #2: October 18 - October 24: DEFEAT VAL HELTHINGS
[*] Reward: Frog Prince Pet
[*] Challenge #3: October 25 - October 31: DEFEAT WEREWOLVES
[*] Reward: Frog Prince Portrait
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/8664a49e13541e4ad8dc0ea088042596adbeceac.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New Cosmetic Sets Debuting with Valhalloween Update[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Wizard Costume: Armor x5 and Equipment x6 
[list][*] [i]Unlocked with Golden Horns in the Shop[/i]
[/list]
[*] Goblin Costume: Armor x5 and Equipment x6
[list][*] [i]Unlocked with Platinum Coins in the Shop[/i]
[/list]
[*] Geirröðr Set: Armor x5 and Equipment x6
[list][*][i] Unlocked with Platinum Coins in the Shop[/i]
[/list]
[*] Hálogi Set: Armor x5 and Equipment x6
[list][*] [i]Unlocked with Platinum Coins in the Shop[/i]
[/list]
[*] Angrboða Set: Armor x5 and Equipment x6
[list][*] [i]Unlocked with Platinum Coins in the Shop[/i]
[/list]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/71aa23fa7fe57df4bb54481e77a869f3db45c6b7.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New Pets Debuting with Valhalloween Update[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Frog Prince Pet[/b] - Princess Linda’s magical long lost BFF has made his dramatic entrance, and he’s as majestic as we could have hoped for!
[list][*][i] Unlocked by completing festive Challenge #2 during Valhalloween[/i]
[/list][*] [b]Vybyn[/b] - Goblin spy sent out to steal secrets, or super friendly little buddy who just wants to vibe out with the Einherjar? Either way, he’s cute as Hel. 
[list]
[*] [i]Unlocked with Platinum Coins in the Shop[/i]
[/list][*] [b]Little Geirrö[/b] - Before he was a frozen mountain of ice-cold fury, this little ice cube just wanted to be a superhero. Whatever happened, you’re still our hero little Geirrö - stay frosty! 
[list]
[*][i] Unlocked with Platinum Coins in the Shop[/i]
[/list][*] [b]Little Hálo[/b] - Yes, he grew a molten beard that young. Some say it even helped with his cooking! Just watch out for his fiery sneezing.
[list]
[*] [i]Unlocked with Platinum Coins in the Shop[/i]
[/list][*] [b]Little Angr[/b] - The little terror of the Nine Realms. Don’t take your eyes off of her for too long, you’ll regret it! 
[list]
[*][i] Unlocked with Platinum Coins in the Shop[/i]
[/list]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/e97c8107c693f6b1f0058eb340e7533bb6578ca4.png[/img]

[h3][b]Valhalloween Update - Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized a number of performance issues caused by having a lot of Constructions active in a single World
[*] In our efforts to better optimize mass Constructions, we fixed a number of issues in which people were loading into games and falling through the World
[*] Fixed an issue in which Door Constructions' open/close animations would not always play
[*] Fixed an issue with controller placement direction when rotating in Build Mode.
[*] Fixed some instances of the ! icon staying indefinitely for new items even after you’ve viewed them.
[*] Fixed an issue in which you could not place the Allforge once you’ve reached the Construction cap. You can now place the Allforge regardless of the cap.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the Bow Firing animations would stagger if the player was moving forward while shooting.
[*] Fixed a rare issue in which Players would return to the Sanctuary when emerging from an Underpass or Hideout
[/list]
[h2]Weekly Live Streams[/h2]

During the month of October, we’ll be streaming each Friday at 3:00pm EST on our Twitch channel as well as on YouTube and Steam! Be sure to tune in as we’ll be reviewing your feedback, Valhalloween outfits, completing challenges, and dropping some SHiFT codes.

Enjoy the haunting season, Vikings, and if you complete the challenges or pick up any of the ghoulish new gear, be sure to tag us so we can see! 👀

Seil seil,
The Norsfell Team

notes.title: Hotfix: Inferno-3.0-1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/0cb0dca02b1eb5e98266f17386d0b85cdbcd5f98.png[/img]

Hiló Vikings!🛠️  We have deployed a Hotfix to resolve issues identified during Season 3, including various crashes and Xbox invite issues.

There's [b]no downtime[/b] - you'll just have to restart Tribes of Midgard to see the changes! 🙌

[h2]Game Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Higher-powered Enemies now also drop the basic Materials of their lower-powered counterparts, in addition to their usual higher-tier Materials. 
[list]
[*] [i]For example, weaker Unsunken Warriors drop Yarn, while the strongest Unsunken Warriors drop Spun Yarn. Now, the strongest Unsunken Warriors will also drop Yarn in addition to Spun Yarn. Journal entries for these enemies were updated to reflect their full loot possibilities.[/i]
[/list]
[/list][h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Xbox, PlayStation] Fixed a crash that could occur when exiting a World just as the Console is going into a suspend state 
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when specific inputs were pressed during game loading
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur during the fishing sequence
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when harvesting Resource nodes with the Spear equipped
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when completing the Rune Scribe Challenge
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when respawning from the Hunter’s Totem
[*] Fixed an issue in which the Embers Armor Set did not have accurate Temperature  protection values. It now correctly has a much higher protection against Heat
[*] Fixed a number of issues that could happen as a result of idling or restoring a lost connection in the Tutorial
[*] Fixed an issue in which VFX from the Surtr’s Spire Spear could linger during certain animations

notes.title: Season 3 Post Launch: Top FAQ, Known Issues, Construction Limit - Dev Blog #4
notes.content:
Hiló Vikings,

It’s been just about [b]two weeks since the launch of Season 3[/b], and since Tribes of Midgard newly arrived to players on Xbox and Nintendo Switch! In case you’re new here (hello, welcome!!) or need a quick reminder, here’s just some of what rolled in with the Inferno Saga update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/7d2b3206944b96e45312139529b4b8f91a704c29.png[/img]

We wanted to take today to talk about your feedback, upcoming improvements, and celebrate what we’ve seen you create so far! Let’s get into it.

[h2]Survival Mode Changes & Construction System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/c60ffc185e9602bff7e39fe5d2c4246d5dba306b.jpg[/img]

First and foremost, we have seen that you have been reaching the limit for Constructions. We completely understand the desire to build bigger, better, and more creative Viking settlements, and it’s one of our top priorities to increase this limitation.

In all transparency, the cap was set in place due to technical limitations, and we’re working on revamping that system to see what’s viable, while ensuring the game remains as stable as possible. We expect the increase in Constructions [b]to take effect in game early October[/b], aligning with our Valhalloween update. 

We’ll stay in close touch and let you know as soon as this change can be made - thank you so much for your understanding and patience. It’s not just the Construction limit that we're looking into - we’re also looking into Construction height, pulling Materials directly from Storage Chests, and alerts to prevent dismantling a Storage Chest that contains Items, among a few.

[h2]Top FAQ[/h2]

We also wanted to recap some of the top-asked questions this past week or so:
[list]
[*] [b]Where can Yarn be found?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yarn can be found on Unsunken Enemies at Ash Beach (Survival + Saga), or, it can be crafted through the Tanning Station (Survival) or Tinker (Saga).
[/list]
[*] [b]Do Ancients respawn in Survival Mode?[/b]
[list]
[*] No, Ancients do not respawn in Survival Mode (however, we’re always open to feedback and this may change in the future). Jötnar respawn and they will level up. 
[/list]
[*] [b]Where can I find Quest Fragments in Survival Mode?[/b]
[list]
[*] You must craft the Artifact Altar. First, you’ll craft the Mining Cutter from the Allforge. Then from the Mining Cutter, you can craft the Artifact Altar, so long as you have a strand of Angrboða’s hair.
[*] We are also exploring bringing Quest NPCs to Survival Mode in Season 4.
[/list]
[*] [b]How can I Repair items in Survival Mode?[/b]
[list]
[*] You repair for Souls using the Allforge (deployable anytime from the Build Menu).
[/list]
[/list]If you ever have more game questions, don’t hesitate to pop by our Discord.

[h2]Reporting Issues and Upcoming Hotfix[/h2]

If you’re experiencing any bugs or issues, similarly please be sure to either [url=https://discord.gg/tribesofmidgard]head to our Discord[/url] or [url=https://forums.tribesofmidgard.com/index.php]Forums[/url] to receive real-time assistance. You can find the full list of currently [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/858820/discussions/1/3183485686830191859/]known issues here.[/url]

There will be an upcoming hotfix to address some known issues, particularly surrounding game stability, including:
[list]
[*] Higher powered enemies will now also drop the basic Materials of their lower-powered counterparts, in addition to Refined Materials. 
[list]
[*] [i]For example, weaker Unsunken Warriors drop Yarn, while the strongest Unsunken Warriors drop Spun Yarn. Now, the strongest Unsunken Warriors will also drop Yarn in addition to Spun Yarn.[/i]
[/list][*] Multiple fixes relating to various crash issues [All platforms]
[*] Fixed an issue in which Survival Sessions were not listed as Joinable from the Friend’s List [Xbox]
[*] Fixed an issue in which players were unable to send Invites from Private Survival Worlds [Xbox]
[*] And more, to be shared very soon!
[/list]
[h2]Guides[/h2]

We've seen some great guides created by our community, and others have been created in our Forum, you can check those out here:
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ROkimg-_6WU]Triple G’s Complete Guide to Survival[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PDGByLfHOUY]A Powerpoint Guide to Surtr[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WoMU5k-qUBE]Jade PG Guide to Summer and Winter in Survival Mode[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.tribesofmidgard.com/index.php?threads/10-tips-and-tricks-to-playing-tribes-of-midgard.1135/]10 Tips and Tricks to Playing Tribes of Midgard[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.tribesofmidgard.com/index.php?threads/the-sundial-world-clock-in-tribes-of-midgard-explained.1195/]The World Clock Explained[/url]
[/list]
[h2]Community Highlights[/h2]

Though we are working to address the Construction limit and other pain points, we’ve so far seen some pretty awesome builds submitted in our Discord. Here’s just a few of them we wanted to feature:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/ebf79b1f2677160b35ef5f77d305f5af46a8195d.png[/img]
[i]So many cozy homes.[/i]

And lastly, how could we not share this impeccable Linnorm Costume?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/9b4fc25be9f47cb8315a3e28a9851532807b7d24.jpg[/img]
[i]Created by Discord member MattBarr[/i]

Be sure to join us on Discord or Twitter to hear all the latest news, and to chat with us directly! We’re still taking in plenty of feedback, and aiming to address some of your top concerns and suggestions. 

Thanks for the trust and patience - we hope you’re otherwise having a great time taking down Surtr!

Talk soon, and seil seil,
The Norsfell Team

Discord: https://www.discord.gg/tribesofmidgard
Twitter: https://twitter.com/tribesofmidgard

Instagram: https://www.Instagram.com/tribesofmidgard

notes.title: Tribes of Midgard - The Anniversary Festive Event has begun!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/32c346160d28f27c06619672083b9500689c9356.png[/img]
[h2]1 Year Anniversary Event[/h2]
[i]August 23rd to September 12th, 2022[/i]

Long ago, legend foretold of a so called “Chickem”... and it all truly began as a *very weird* rumor within our Discord. Some said you had to hold a Golden Egg for 100 days to hatch the perfect chicken pet, and some theorized that completing the Roosters Event granted you this special feathery fellow…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/c39f7046d88ce99e96ca91452b733be57024fbdb.jpg[/img]

Whether that’s true or not, we now celebrate [b]ONE YEAR[/b] since launch with our Anniversary Event, complete with a Ragnarooster Cosmetic Set, 3 feathery Rooster Pets, one very special Chickem Pet and Portrait as well as 3 brand new Festive Challenges!

Dare we say - have a clucking great time in Midgard!

[h3][b]1 Year of Tribes of Midgard![/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New Anniversary Logo will greet you as you enter the Main Menu, combined with an equally festive variant of the theme music!
[*] The Main Menu, Sanctuary and Village have received a festive makeover to celebrate one year of defending Midgard against the forces of Ragnarök!
[*] Main Menu has also received an equally festive variant of the theme music!
[*] Costumed Goblins and Unsunkens have invaded Midgard, eager to spread festive cheer (and pain).
[/list]
[h3][b]Festive Challenges:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] During the Anniversary Event, there will be 3 Festive Challenges that can only be completed during this limited time event.
[*] There will be one Festive Challenge per Week
[*] Complete these challenges to earn Platinum Coins and a unique Anniversary Portrait for your Viking.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/38f94d94d75fbbeff502a2f8f67181577e89bd3d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Anniversary Cosmetics:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Ragnarooster Set[/b]
[list]
[*] The mighty Ragnarooster has graced the Nine Realms with its presence to help celebrate this joyous occasion!
[*] Armor x5
[*] Weapons x5
[*] Shield
[*] [i]Unlocked through the Shop via Platinum Coins[/i][/list]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/7bd20dbfd650581b755f5f1b84b77d0375d3629a.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Pet - Gullinkambi the Rooster[/b]
[list][*] One of the three Roosters of Ragnarök, this golden rooster is no stranger to living the high-life, spending most of its time dancing for the gods up in Valhalla
[*][i]Unlocked through the Shop via Platinum Coins[/i][/list]
[*][b]Pet - Fjalar the Rooster[/b]
[list][*] One of the three Roosters of Ragnarök, this crimson rooster of Jötunheim is the loudest of them all after spending too much time with the Jotnar.
[*][i]Unlocked through the Shop via Platinum Coins[/i][/list]
[*][b]Pet - The Unnamed Rooster[/b]
[list][*] One of the three Roosters of Ragnarök, this enigmatic soot-red rooster has picked up an odd trick or two after returning from Niflheim.
[*][i]Unlocked through the Shop via Platinum Coins[/i][/list]
[*][b]Pet - Chickem[/b]
[list][*] The legend, the myth, the Chickem. Available to all for [b]FREE[/b] via the Shop while the Anniversary Event is active!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/dc2b7a3ac5095c4a81ebf62b07bde49410854f46.gif[/img]

[*][b]Anniversary Portrait[/b]
[list][*] [i]Unlocked through Week 2 Festive Challenge Reward[/i][/list]
[*] [b]Chickem Portrait[/b]
[list][*] [i]Unlocked through SHiFT Code[/i][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/89dbc44f80ed4d65772361734bbe690f357be88e.png[/img]
KCRJ3-HCH5F-TT3TJ-B3TJJ-XKJJ3[/list]
See you there, and cheers to one year! Thank you for your continued support and feedback - we are monitoring closely and will be letting you know of incoming fixes and adjustments in the weeks to come.

Seil seil,
The Norsfell Team

notes.title: Season 3: Inferno Saga Patch Notes August 16, 2022
notes.content:
[i]Tribes of Midgard[/i] Season 3 is LIVE!
[previewyoutube=UZJYHXL0W9k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858820/view/3409807423270532623][i]Read the “New Features” Blog Post for even more detail![/i][/url]

[list][*][b]New Saga Quest: Inferno[/b]
[list][*]Added support for Saga Quest: Inferno to guide entry into the Volcanic Spire to face the biggest threat to Midgard yet, Surtr![/list]
[*][b]New Biome: Volcanic Spire[/b]
[list][*]Added support for the new volcanic Biome, including all new Creatures, Materials, Camps, and Hazards to discover.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/bfb5547b0f07f5c086d25a99bb79e7bfe9cf0a6a.jpg[/img]
[*][b]New Ancient: Surtr[/b]
[list][*]Surtr has launched an all-out invasion from his lair at the peak of the Volcanic Spire. Fight your way to him to prevent burning the world from his volcanic fire![/list]
[*][b]Revenge of the Ancients:[/b]
[list][*]Saga Bosses are now referred to by their Midgardian moniker of ‘Ancients’ in all relevant in-game messaging and text.[/list]
[*][b]New Weapon Type: Spear[/b]
[list][*]Added a new Weapon type, Spear! This has considerable linear reach compared to other Weapons.
[*]The starting Villager Spear is crafted with only Wood, perfect for fighting off enemies early!
[list][*][i]See the Crafting Section of the Patch Notes for a breakdown of the available Spears[/i][/list][/list]
[*][b]New Activity: Fishing[/b]
[list][*]Craft Fishing Rods to interact with Mysterious Ripples appearing in the water.
[*]Interacting with the Mysterious Ripples starts a time-sensitive mini-game for additional Materials used in new recipes.
[list][*][i]See the Content Section for types of Fishable loot, as well as the Crafting Section for what Recipes they can be used in[/i][/list][/list]
[*][b]Revamped Game Over Screens[/b]
[list]
[*]See more stats in three Game Over screens you can review or skip:
[list][*][b]Global Results:[/b] Includes World stats such as Map Information, Enemies Slain, and Time Elapsed.
[*][b]Team Results:[/b] Shows player information, including Character Levels and a top stat consisting of their highest score.
[*][b]Personal Results:[/b] The final showcase of all noteworthy statistics accrued during the session, as well as where Season XP is tallied.[/list][/list][/list]

[h2]Survival 2.0[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/9b0d482de641a8719717172c2c4f433391dd758c.png[/img]
[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858820/view/3368148492288843855]Read the Survival 2.0 Blog Post for even more details![/url][/i]

[b]Survival Mode[/b] has been fully rebuilt from the ground up!  Our aim with this re-work is to transform Survival into a more relaxed but equally exciting [i]Tribes of Midgard[/i] experience. You can read the individual details on the Survival 2.0 Blog Post.
[list][*][b]Core Gameplay:[/b]
[list][*]No longer locked behind Season Level 2.
[*]No Village = No Village to defend at night.
[*]Days will last longer at 20 minutes each.
[*]Helthings will spawn sporadically throughout the environment at night but will not attack the Seed of Yggdrasil.
[*]Jötnar have their own Arenas that you can choose to travel to and defeat whenever you want.[/list]
[*][b]Saga Quests in Survival:[/b]
[list][*]Saga Quests unlock powerful Crafting Stations that will allow you to sail to new lands, craft better loot, and take on greater challenges.[/list]
[*][b]Session-Based Blessing Tree and Level Progression:[/b]
[list][*]An entirely new Blessing Tree has been created for the game mode that allows for more freedom to pick and choose among 90 Blessings as you see fit.
[*]Increased the Max Character Level to 50.
[*]No Shared Character XP.[/list]
[*][b]Season/Meta Progression:[/b]
[list][*]Season XP has a chance to drop from activities.
[*]Defeating powerful enemies or raiding Camps guarantees large amounts of Season XP.
[*]Season XP is automatically attributed to your Account Profile and contributes to Season Progress.[/list]
[*][b]Large Worlds, tailored to Survival Mode: [/b]
[list][*]Players start on a large, central continent and will be able to explore the open seas as they progress through the Saga Quests.
[*]Added new ways to encourage exploration via Crafting at the Allforge
[list][*][b]Craft Beds:[/b] Beds can be claimed to serve as Respawn points.
[*][b]Craft Bonfires:[/b] Bonfires will help keep you warm in cold climates so long as you deposit Branches to keep the fires alive.
[*][b]Craft Shrines:[/b] Shrines act as Fast Travel points, allowing you and your Tribe to build your own travel network throughout Midgard![/list][/list]
[*][b]Players are equipped with the Allforge:[/b]
[list][*]All crafting in Survival 2.0 centers around the building of these specific Crafting Stations for whatever you might need.
[list][*]Crafting Stations can be upgraded to unlock more powerful recipes and even entirely new stations.
[*][i]See the Content Section below for a breakdown of all the new Construction pieces available as of the launch of Inferno Saga.[/i][/list][*]The Allforge is located in the Build Menu and can be placed anywhere, free of material costs.[list][*]Only one Allforge per person can be deployed at a time.[/list][*]The Allforge will repair Equipment for a standard Souls Cost.
[*]Crafting Stations, Constructions, and Decorations are all crafted from the Allforge.[/list]
[*][b]Updated Construction to be more modular and significantly more flexible:[/b]
[list][*]Constructions are scaled to fit a 1x1x1 area for increased interconnectivity.
[*]Walls, pillars, roofs, and doors have been added.
[*]Constructions are available in three tiers with different levels of strength and material requirements.
[*]The camera is able to be rotated while in the Build Menu.
[*]Constructions are able to be placed along the Z-Axis.
[*]The Mallet is now triggered by default in the Build Menu:
[list][*]Dismantle by highlighting the Construction you want to remove.
[*]Repair Constructs in the Build Menu.[/list][/list]
[*][b]Freyja’s chatty cats Sóleyra and Mániklo have arrived:[/b]
[list][*]They help new Einherjar as they interact with certain triggers in the environment for the first time.[/list]
[*][b]Mode selection improvements:[/b]
[list][*]Survival is now showcased on the Main Play tab alongside Saga Mode.
[*]The new Survival 2.0 game mode now comes with the option to play in a Solo session just like Saga Mode. 
[*]Players can now form Groups via Invite to Join or Create a Survival 2.0.[/list][/list]

[h2]Blessing Updates[/h2]
With [b]Inferno Saga[/b], every Class received [b]2[/b] brand new Blessings, with some receiving changes to an existing Blessing.

Blessings are a vital part of [i]Tribes of Midgard’s[/i] genre-blending [i]Surthrival[/i] gameplay, and we wanted to take the opportunity with Inferno Saga to re-evaluate how each of the Classes is performing and how the community has been utilizing their Blessings to create unique play styles. 

As mentioned in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858820/view/3368148492288843855]Survival 2.0 Blog[/url] post, the class system has been taken out of Survival Mode in favor of a brand new Blessing Tree. Different skills will be unlockable as you increase your Character Level during gameplay. These additional skills and changes will be included in the Blessing Tree for Survival Mode as well.

To read more about the changes, read the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858820/view/3409807423270286459]Blessing and Combat Updates Blog post[/url]. 

[list][*][b]Warrior[/b]
[list][*][b]Underdog[/b] [NEW]: Feeling surrounded? Great! Increase damage dealt per each nearby enemy. 
[*][b]Warrior-Gatherer[/b] [NEW]: Labor like the Warrior gods of old! Combo attacks from any Weapon can now break Resource nodes, retrieving their precious Materials without Tools. Everything’s an axe!
[*][b]Reckless Roll[/b] [UPDATED]: Now avoid damage throughout the entire Evade roll animation.[/list]
[*][b]Ranger[/b]
[list][*][b]Ullr’s Step II[/b] [NEW]: Ullr’s Step now triggers a rain of arrows on your original position, dealing [medium] physical damage over time.
[*][b]Ricochet[/b] [NEW]: Each arrow fired has a 50% chance to ricochet, bouncing to up to 3 additional enemies.
[*][b]Quickshot[/b] [UPDATED]: Was originally affecting Arrow flight speed and now affects the attack speed of Bow Combo Attacks.[/list]
[*][b]Guardian[/b]
[list][*][b]Pain Release II[/b] [NEW]: Let it all out! Gain increased attack and movement speed for 5 seconds after unleashing your Pain.
[*][b]Unwavering[/b] [NEW]: The judgment of Forseti is absolute. Stand your ground against any who would dare say otherwise by becoming immune to knockback effects.[/list]
[*][b]Seer[/b]
[list][*][b]Yggdrasil’s Roots II[/b] [NEW]: Enemies entering the Seedling’s radius receive damage from the roots of the World Tree. Wouldn’t want to be on its bad side.
[*][b]Sacred Revive[/b] [NEW]: Further empowered by the golden apples of youth, reviving allies now triggers a healing pool in the area, granting HP over time.
[*][b]Tempered[/b] [UPDATED]: Now generates an aura that reduces Temperature effects for you and nearby allies.[/list]
[*][b]Berserker[/b]
[list][*][b]Undying Anger[/b] [NEW]: Channel the rage of war. Automatically self-revive when down and receive healing based on your current Wrath.
[*][b]Wrath Soothed[/b] [UPDATED]: Gain HP for every enemy hit by your Blast.
[*][b]Battle Resistance II[/b] [UPDATED]: Chance to resist Stun/Slow effects increased from 75% to 100%.[/list]
[*][b]Hunter[/b]
[list][*][b]Skaði’s Spirit II[/b] [NEW]: Your Decoy is now armed with a Bow and will fire Arrows at nearby enemies.
[*][b]Skaði’s Wolf[/b] [NEW]: Roll to deploy Skaði’s kindred spirit that will attack nearby enemies. Go get ’em boy!
[*][b]Skaði’s Spirit I[/b] [UPDATED]: There is now a visual indicator to show the Decoy’s taunt radius.[/list]
[*][b]Sentinel[/b]
[list][*][b]Shield Throw II[/b] [NEW]: Your Shield Throw ability now throws the second shield in rapid succession.
[*][b]Shield Ring II[/b] [NEW]: Shield spin to win. Your Shield Ring ability will now revolve around you a second time, dealing damage and effects twice.[/list]
[*][b]Warden[/b]
[list][*][b]Secret Stash[/b] [NEW]: Vigilance is key when safeguarding a Village’s supplies, and their trade secrets! Materials carried are no longer lost upon defeat.
[*][b]Rationing[/b] [NEW]: An Einherjar knows how important rationing can be in dire times. Gain a 25% chance to recover a Meal immediately after use.
[*][b]Dwarven Made[/b] [UPDATED]: Now reduces Repair costs & Equipment Durability loss by 50%.[/list]
[*][b]Blessing Trees[/b]
[list][*]Most Classes have received an update to the layout of their Blessing Trees.
[*]With the advent of new and updated Blessings, this new layout should also make it easier to navigate each, with a better grouping of related Blessings.[/list][/list]

[h2]Combat Update[/h2]

[*][b]Changes to Invincibility Frames:[/b]
[list][*]Applied i-Frames when Evading to all Characters.
[list][*][i]The Warrior’s Reckless Roll Blessing has been updated[/i][/list][/list]
[*][b]Changes to Animation Cancelling:[/b]
[list][*]Added Animation Cancelling when Evading/Blocking.[/list]
[*][b]Changes to Mana Gains:[/b]
[list][*]Successfully blocking enemy attacks with a Shield will now reward additional Mana. 
[list][*]Guardians will synergize well with this change, as their [i]Refused Judgement[/i] Blessing will allow them to gain even more Mana per Shield block.[/list][*]You now earn a set amount of Mana per attack, regardless of how many enemies were struck in that attack.[/list]
[*][b]Changes to Durability Loss:[/b]
[list][*]Similar to Mana Gains, your Weapon will now only lose a set amount of durability per attack, regardless of how many enemies were struck.[/list]
[*][b]Mana Loss from Powerful Foes:[/b]
[list][*]Being struck by Powerful Foes will leave you winded, causing you to lose a bit of Mana from your gauge.
[list][*]Powerful Foes include Jötnar, Elites (red skull indicator), Ancients, and the roaming mini-bosses of Midgard (yellow health bar).[/list][/list]
[*][b]Combat Feel and Weapon Tuning:[/b]
[list][*]Slight increase to the camera shake and sense of weight from Attack SFX when landing a hit, adjusted per Weapon type.
[list][*]Added the option in Settings to adjust camera shaking on a scale.[/list][*]Animation timing has been adjusted for all Weapon types, to better hone-in on their combat identity and gameplay niches.[list]
[*]The Bow has received a more notable overhaul:
[*]Damage of standard combo attacks has been significantly increased.
[*]Damage and speed of Aimed / Charged Shots were reduced.
[*]Durability increased.[/list][/list]

[h2]Crafting[/h2]
[h3]Survival Crafting Update[/h3]
Crafting in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858820/view/3368148492288843855]Survival Update[/url] is handled differently. To replace the handiwork of the Saga Mode Villagers is no easy task, but luckily Survival players will be able to replicate everything they do (and more!) with our trusty new [b]Crafting Stations[/b]. Simply enter Build Mode, then the Build Menu to get started by building your [b]Allforge[/b]. Crafting Stations can be upgraded to provide more recipes, but some may have special conditions before they can be built.

[list][*][b]Allforge:[/b] The central crafting station from which all others are born. Does not cost anything to put down, but you can only have one at a time. It can also repair your Equipment!
[*][b]Crafting Stations – Exclusively in Survival Mode:[/b]
[list][*][b]Bed:[/b] Place it to serve as your Respawn Point when claimed. 
[*][b]Tool Grinder:[/b] For crafting all Tools, including the new Fishing Rods.
[*][b]Meal Cauldron:[/b] For crafting the new Meal recipes.
[*][b]Potion Brewer:[/b] For crafting Potions. 
[list][*][i]Unlocked through Survival 2.0 Saga Quest progress.[/i][/list][*][b]Weapon Furnace:[/b] For crafting Weapons.
[*][b]Shield Rack:[/b] For crafting Shields.
[*][b]Armor Loom[/b]: For crafting Armor.
[*][b]Defense Workshop:[/b] For crafting Traps and Watchtowers.[list][*][i]Unlocked through Survival 2.0 Saga Quest progress.[/i][/list][*][b]Ammunition Shelf:[/b] For crafting specialized Arrows.
[*][b]Boat Dock:[/b] For crafting Boats.[list][*][i]Unlocked through Survival 2.0 Saga Quest progress.[/i][/list][*][b]Lumbering Stand:[/b] For crafting Wood-based Ingredients.
[*][b]Tanning Stand:[/b] For crafting Leather, Fur, and Yarn Ingredients.
[*][b]Mining Stand:[/b] For crafting Stone, Ore, and Iron Ingredients.
[*][b]Artifact Altar:[/b] For crafting Artifacts.
[list][*][i]Unlocked through Survival 2.0 Saga Quest progress.[/i][/list][*][b]Construction Bench / Rig / Table:[/b] For crafting Constructions, like Walls, Stairs, Roofs, etc. 
[*][b]Portal Shrine:[/b] For fast-travel between other Shrines.
[*][b]Bonfire:[/b] Provides warmth. Must deposit kindling with Branches to activate and increase the duration
[*][b]Storage Box / Trunk / Chest:[/b] A deployable Storage container to deposit and share resources with your Tribe (or for your own safekeeping). Inventory space is upgraded by building higher rarity Storage Boxes from improved Constructions Stations.
[/list]
[*][b]New Construction Pieces:[/b]
[list][*]The Survival Update comes equipped with a plethora of new and adjusted Construction pieces. 
[*]Construction pieces in Survival Mode have been globally scaled down to 1×1 or 1x1x1 in terms of grid size, to increase interconnectivity and customization options.
[*]Each Construction type comes in three tiers; ranging from twig/thatch and wood to slate/stone.
[list][*][b]Ground[/b] – Twig/Wooden/Stone

[list][*][i]Includes an Archer to fight off nearby enemies. Can deposit more powerful Arrows to increase effectiveness.[/i][/list][*][b]Eir Effigy of Life:[/b]
[list][*]Activate to Heal over time[/list][*][b]Eir Effigy of Haste:[/b]

[h2]General Crafting Updates[/h2]
[list][*] [b]New Consumables Recipes: Meals[/b]
[list][*]As of Inferno Saga and the debut of Survival 2.0, we’ve added an additional crafting tree for recipes; Meals! 
[*]Meals usually rely on natural ingredients and provide buffs and healing similar to Potions.
[*]Meal effects tend to be weaker in potency and immediacy compared to Potions, but can be carried in higher quantities.

[*][b]Fish Platter:[/b] Large Heal.

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/24c4d6997864da1195868b2349e5fa459b15c73f.png[/img]
[*][b]New Creature: Lavættir[/b]
[list][*]A manifestation of Surtr’s wrath, these fiery elementals are born of molten flame and return to it upon death. They are vengeful to the bitter end. After taking enough damage, they will double into smaller, more numerous forms, until finally becoming highly volatile explosives unto themselves. Be careful when delivering that final blow.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/67732500cc71632c1ab558e9e46e3a95349594f7.png[/img]
[*][b]New Creature: Brennálfar Witch[/b]
[list][*]The Brennálfar have Witches of their own, and of course, they’re pyromaniacs!
[*]Known to stalk the Volcanic Spire, watch out for their fiery orbs; they’re slow-moving, but you don’t want to be around when one goes off.
[list][*]Rumors swirl that the most fearsome of Brennálfar Witches, Aska and Edlur, have made their way to the Volcanic Spire to protect their master’s Lair. These Elites will not go down without a fight.
[/list][/list]
[*][b]New Creature: Brennálfar Watchtower[/b]
[list][*]These fortified Watchtowers are the backbone of any Múspel invasion force. Capable of being built rapidly, they provide Brennálfar Archers with ideal vantage points and defensible positions to ruin any Miðgarðian’s day.[/list]
[*][b]New Creature: Fire Turret[/b]
[list][*]Dotting the entrenched pathways of the Volcanic Camps, these flame-spewing turrets protect the Camp’s treasure from foolhardy Einherjar itching for a raid[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/f239a9c89144f00d73ad169ef8e71c3340f68f9a.png[/img]
[*][b]New Creature: Múspelorm [/b]
[list][*]When two Linnorms fight, they use their massive tails to launch their opponents across unfathomable distances. Legend has it, no one truly knew where the losing Linnorms ended up, until now. Turns out, they were somehow launched into faraway Múspelheim, where over time, their forms evolved to not only handle the immeasurable heat of this Realm but to wield it as well. Now they’re back in Miðgarð, and they breathe fire.[/list]
[*][b]New Creature: Sormr[/b]
[list][*]Vile spawn of Jörmungandr that have slithered their way into the Open Seas.
[*]The Sormr will poke their heads above water to spit projectiles at any nearby Boats, so keep a watchful eye out when sailing your Drakkar. [/list]
[*][b]New Critters:[/b]
[list][*]We’ve added 5 more non-hostile wildlife critters to further flesh out the Biomes and provide an additional source of Materials like Fur and Feathers.
[list][*][b]Fox:[/b] found in the Bright Forest
[*][b]Hare:[/b] found in the Bright Forest
[*][b]Arctic Fox:[/b] found in the Glacier Peaks
[*][b]Snowy Owl:[/b] found in the Glacier Peaks
[*][b]Vulture:[/b] found in the Volcanic Spire
[/list][/list]
[*][b]New Camp: Outposts[/b]
[list][*]As part of Surtr’s invasion strategy, a number of Volcanic Outposts have been seen emerging across every Biome in Midgard
[*]These emergent encampments contain a host of Surtr’s forces that can be quick to overwhelm you if you stumble into one unprepared.
[*]However, if you manage to clear one out, their treasure chests are known to contain items of great importance to Surtr’s war effort. Would be a real shame if you were to use these items against him.[/list]
[*][b]New Camp: Volcanic Spire Camps[/b]
[list][*]Scattered throughout the Volcanic Spire are a number of heavily fortified encampments for Surtr’s forces.
[*]These entrenched Camps are a gauntlet of challenges, containing tight passages loaded with Fire Turrets spewing flame, Watchtowers firing on you from afar, and a whole squadron of molten defenders looking to protect their treasure.[/list]
[*][b]New Camp: The Lair Entrance[/b]
[list][*]The peak of the Volcanic Spire is the most heavily fortified of Surtr’s Camps. In order to gain access to Surtr’s Lair, you’ll have to ascend to the final steps, beyond a moat of molten lava, and defeat his two Elite Generals.[/list]
