notes.title: Update Notes - Wolf 1.02
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/71c38094f73d493a919373359a4194b0be969b8a.jpg[/img]

Hi Vikings,
Maintenance is over! Please make sure to download the update to version: wolf-1.02! Here are the list of changes. 🐺

[b]Content[/b]
[list][*] The Reward for achieving Season Level 49 in Season 1 has been correctly updated to the Wolf Saga portrait. A sneaky Goblin Chief tried to claim the slot for himself! He has since been sacked. [/list]
[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
[list][*] Alvis Hammer II
[list][*]Healing Spell increased to 400 from 300
[/list][*] Soul Powered Rune
[list][*]Damage bonus reduced to 5 from 10 per stack of 100 Souls
[*] Souls Cap correctly set to 10,000
[/list][*] Banner Time Rune
[list][*]Ticks every 3 seconds, up from 1
[*]Healing increased to 150 from 50[/list][/list]
[b]Quality of Life[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now dismantle Enchanted Tripwire traps if they are blocking their path
[*] PC players can now press the (B) Key as a shortcut for the Blessings menu
[*] Changed Rebuild input for Farm, Quarry, Lumberyard and Bridge from [b]"F"[/b] on Keyboard (Square Button on Controller) to "[b]G" [/b]on Keyboard (L1 Button on Controller) to avoid interaction conflicts
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed some issues in World Generation that were causing Giants to get stuck on their path of destruction
[*]Fixed an issue during the Tutorial where Geirröðr’s snowball would clip into the ground
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the Unsunken Boss from holding his axe properly during movement animation
[*] Fixed issues with the impact animations for some Helthings that were not playing the appropriate animation
[*] Fixed an issue where the Witch’s spells could stick for too long
[*] Fixed an issue where the Witch could damage out of combat players from far away with her Spells
[*] Fixed an issue where enemy Spells would fire in a direction they weren’t facing
[*] Fixed numerous AI issues that caused certain enemies to idle after chasing for a time
[*] Fixed an issue where Trölls could sometimes not exit their Camps
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed players to keep racking up hits against Fenrir during his death animation, especially when paired with the Soul Mate Rune (poor Fenrir)
[*] Fixed an issue where some players were unable to craft using a Controller when returning to a Solo save file
[*] Fixed an issue where players were able to block their own Banner Time Rune’s healing when facing a certain direction
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed you to block damage while performing other actions if you used the Shield button
[*] Fixed an issue that sometimes made it difficult to revive downed Villagers if they were downed from a Jötunn
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause a player to enter Downed State instead of Drowning if they died from fall damage when hitting the water
[*] Fixed an issue where the Healing Brew was not healing for the correct amount of time
[*] Fixed multiple issues of Cosmetics clipping into each other
[*] Fixed an issue where the Hunter’s Recall Totem would linger on the Map even if not active
[*] Fixed an issue where Hunter’s Trap Stacker wasn’t allowing the player to stack Traps properly when buying them from a merchant
[*] Fixed an issue where Warden’s Rune Carver ability wouldn’t always allow for 6 Runes to be equipped
[*] Fixed an issue where players could retain the benefits of the Nothing to Hide Rune by unequipping then re-equipping their armor
[*] Fixed an issue where the Like a Dwarf Rune was not granted the appropriate Armor bonuses
[*] Fixed an issue where Warriors could be invincible while in Downed State if they died due to fall damage with the Reckless Roll Blessing
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes Járnsaxa would be instantly defeated during the transition to her second form
[*] Fixed an issue where players could block incoming heals.
[*] Fixed an issue where Feral Armor was protecting against Heat instead of Cold
[*] Fixed an issue where archers in Archer Towers would speak like Dökkalfar and spam their voice over lines (they were just being too passionate about Village defense).
[*] Fixed an issue affecting the progress icons for the ‘Life on the Farm’ Quest
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause Quest progression to break or not update correctly if you Save/Quit at certain points in the Quest chain
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed players to roll into the trap doors to proceed to the next level of a Hideout
[*] Fixed an issue where Treasures in Camps could sometimes be accessed from beneath
[*] Fixed an issue where rapidly transitioning back and forth from Fenrir’s Lair caused the screen to become permanently black
[*] Fixed an issue where a character could get stuck in a Land of Pools Small Camp when jumping off a ramp
[*] Fixed an issue where on rare occasions Fenrir would fail to appear and attack the player in his Lair
[*] Fixed an issue where Fenrir would land on the broken stones as he enters the fight
[*] Fixed an issue with missing sound effects when interacting with the Eir Effigies
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed players to Fast Travel to Activated Shrines even when not near another Shrine
[*] Fixed an issue that could sometimes cause players to spawn under Fenrir’s Lair if they teleported back to it
[*] Fixed an issue where cancelling Recall Totem wouldn’t always work if too far away from it
[*] Fixed an issue where Constructions could be placed in areas of the Village that were not intended
[*] Fixed an issue where Jars could block Underpass and Hideout exits
[*] Fixed an issue where the final Treasure of a Hideout could be interacted with before clearing the area
[*] Fixed an instance where players could be booted to the main menu after triggering a number of Jars then leaving an Underpass or Hideout
[*] Fixed issues with collision trap in enemy Camps, Underpasses and bushes
[*] Fixed some interaction issues when playing with HUD turned off
[*] Fixed issues where the voice chat icon was inconsistently being displayed when a player was speaking
[*] Fixed an issue affecting saved Worlds for Survival Games with over 100 Days played in which progress may be reset
[*] Fixed an issue where the +1 Golden Horn UI wouldn’t always appear in HUD when picking one up
[*] Fixed an issue allowing a player to avoid being kicked for inactivity if they had a menu open
[*] Fixed an issue on PC that didn’t allow players to mouse over Class information properly 
[*] Fixed an issue that prompted an unnecessary message when accessing the Quest Board after all Quests were taken or completed
[*] Fixed an issue that caused replacing current Quests to remove the unfinished Quest from the board for the whole session
[*] Fixed a number of Controller navigation issues for the Journal menus

notes.title: Tribes of Midgard is now available! (Server issue resolved + Launch event)
notes.content:
Hilo Vikings,

After four years of development, we're so excited to announce that [b]Tribes of Midgard is now available on PlayStation and Steam[/b]!

We can't wait to hear what you think of Tribes of Midgard, and hope you're ready to jump into Season One: The Wolf Saga.

[h2]Watch the launch trailer here:[/h2]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xdzmhjUceeA
[h3]Launch Day Server fixes[/h3]

We were aware some players experienced server issues just after our launch. We apologize for this, and moved quick as we could to resolve the issue by upgrading our servers. Things are looking stable and there should be no more issues! Thank you so much for your patience, really, everyone at the team much appreciates your understanding. 

[h3]One Tree Planted Event[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/966b67de690bfd14dbdcdc45705a1b6427f03129.png[/img]

Gearbox and Norsfell have teamed up with One Tree Planted to restore forests around the world! 🌲 For every Giant you slay in-game, Gearbox will plant a tree in your glory. Make Yggdrasil proud! (And don't forget to use #TreesOfMidgard on socials).

Lastly, be sure to [url=https://discord.com/invite/tribesofmidgard]join our Discord[/url] to find a tribe to play with, and come [url=https://twitter.com/tribesofmidgard]hang out on our Twitter[/url] for all the latest news.

The entire Norsfell team is beyond thrilled that today has finally come. We'll be keeping an eye out for your feedback as always! Thank you for all the support these past few years, we could not have done this without our awesome community.

The Norsfell Team 🗻

notes.title: Season 1: The Wolf Saga Trailer Reveal
notes.content:
Hey Vikings,

We have some exciting news today - Tribes of Midgard was featured on the[b] Sony State of Play[/b] yesterday to talk about the free Seasonal Updates that you and your Tribe can expect to see on launch day, July 27th!

We're glad to introduce the [b]The Wolf Saga[/b], which will be available at launch and adds additional challenges, exclusive loot, and a powerful new boss.

[h2]Watch Season 1: The Wolf Saga Trailer[/h2]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zsocvKtnTMw

[h2]Read the Blog for more details![/h2]

Be sure to check out the blog post for an in-depth look at Runes, Events, our Saga Boss, and what awaits you in Midgard: [url=https://blog.playstation.com/2021/07/08/tribes-of-midgard-post-launch-plans-revealed/]https://blog.playstation.com/2021/07/08/tribes-of-midgard-post-launch-plans-revealed/[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/40a2cf8f57b3fe34fddecb56e2278096ee1b0ec4.jpg[/img]

We're beyond excited to send you on your journey to face the first Saga of Tribes of Midgard! We've worked hard to make the final Saga Boss a memorable (and challenging) one - you’re saving the world after all. 

Remember, Einherjar, Midgard needs you. Valhalla can wait!

See you soon,
The Norsfell Team

notes.title: Introducing The Midguardians!
notes.content:
Hey Vikings!

Today, we have some big news to share with you, about game test phases and the Midguardians. 

A year ago, we launched our first Closed Alpha, and had 250 Discord members. That was the first time you were able to try Tribes of Midgard (who remembers the flying trees)?

Today, after 3 Closed Alpha and 3 Open Betas, thousands of you are helping us spread Tribes of Midgard across all social networks. This support allows us to gain an incomparable strength helping us to develop Tribes of Midgard. Thank you again, because you really make a huge difference.

There is still a long way to go and we understand and share your excitement around Tribes of Midgard. We would like to be able to leave the gates open at all times, but being still in development, it is difficult for us to do so. 

It’s for this reason that we announced that our last Open Beta would be in December 2019. But today, we want to share with you what's coming!

[h1]Introducing: The Midguardians![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/80ae857496289320387627682a2a1b36273cda99.png[/img]

Next, are private testing phases, reserved for our most active members and framed in a brand new program: The Midguardians!

[b]What are the Midguardians?[/b]

The Midguardians as we know them today are going to be radically different. A Midguardian is a player who wants to get more involved in the Tribes of Midgard community.

Today, there are 620 Midguardians on our Discord, helping us share Tribes across social networks and getting involved in our Discord. So naturally, we want to reward them, because these small actions add up, and help give us the strength necessary to develop Tribes of MIdgard.

[b]What are the Rewards?[/b]

Rewards include access to private testing phases, and rewards such as in-game cosmetics, swag, and other surprises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/b99df13b925b1b1e54a01364eed4a71327fd152c.png[/img]

[b]How to collect these rewards?[/b]

We have implemented a Level and Points system to make the experience more visible and “fair” for everyone. By being active, you increase levels that allow you to access new rewards.

[b]How to join the Midguardians?[/b]

Everything is free and accessible to everyone! However, we ask to apply via a form in order to have you sign an NDA.
[url=https://www.tribesofmidgard.com/midguardians/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/852ff989876a79bb73a4ba12f3ac77bc333c4b41.png[/img][/url]

[b]Why an NDA?[/b]

Unlike our first 6 test phases, it will not be possible to stream or create content during these private tests, and you must sign an NDA to take part. We want to use these private tests for feedback with which to keep improving the game. 

[h1]What if I’m already a Midguardian?[/h1]
620 people in our Discord joined the first version of the Midguardians. Since it’s now necessary to apply and sign an NDA, we've renamed them, "Midguardians Volunteer". We invite you to apply to become a full Midguardian. It goes without saying that, given your pre-engagement, you will be more likely to be a full Midguardian. Right now, we cannot accept everyone, and plan to have 600 Midguardians at this time to give us time to put everything in place. 

[b]No more Closed Beta/Open Beta?[/b]

We know that we want to offer new testing phases to our community, but at the moment, as we develop the game it is not possible. The Midguardians are a way for us to offer private tests to you, while also allowing us the time to keep working on the game.


We’ll be available on Discord to be answering any and all of your questions, please join here!:

[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/tribesofmidgard][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/ee27962b6258b7875195c50855141c548f82b850.png[/img][/url]

We hope you’re excited for this as we are! Thank you for your support! ⚔️🙏

The Norsfell Team 🗻

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - January 22/20
notes.content:
Hey Vikings,

Last week, we’d been talking about different changes that would affect the game experience and we're on a roll! 

Another aspect of the game that we're working on is making the world feel more "full"- this is one of our focuses this week along with new weapon spells. We've been working on new Camps to add to our swamp biome, the Land of Pools.

[b]This week, we’re:[/b]

🔪 – Designing the level of the Elf Bastion
🔑 – Modelling in 3D the Gate of the Elf Bastion
🌿 – Exploring new Grass system to create Props
🏃 – Updating AI to be able to chase Players further
🛂 – Preparing the opportunity to port the game in Consoles
⛺ – Continuing on finishing the Small Camp for the Land of Pools
📓 – Animating new Spells for new Weapons like the Baldur’s Revenge
🔨 – Fixing various issues for Passwords, Modules, Customization and Logging
📖 – Researching various features for Village Layout, Blessings and Hot/Cold Gauges

[b]Is there any weapon spell you wish to see in the game later on?[/b]

Let us know which ones! If you haven't played the game yet, our weapon spells are based around elemental attacks, so for example, a Dark skill would come from a Dark sword, and its color would be specific to the element (Dark = purple). When fighting, you'll also find opposite elements have better damage against each other, so if you're fighting our Fire Giant (Hàlogi) you'd definitely want to pick up an ice weapon.

Here's how the Dark Whirlwind looks for the Lindworm Sword:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/e4dcc92a9f7ca87a798d4ed87203529873dbe270.gif[/img]

And the Thunderstorm skill for Ymir's Eyelash sword...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/3cc2dc3891898d9a0014d020eba2b181ff94eaa7.gif[/img]

If you're curious and want to read more about all the weapons in-game and each of their skills, check out our Wiki, which is community-made and still expanding!:

https://tribesofmidgard.gamepedia.com/Weapons

See you next week!

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
Here are the multiple changes for the Open Beta 3 of Tribes of Midgard. 
The mix of new mechanics and content added to the game:

[b]General Tasks[/b]
[list]
[*] War Chest available in the Village to share loot 
[*] Command System to communicate 
[*] Unsunken Javelin Vikings featured in the World (new enemy)
[*] Helthing Boss featured in Blood Moons (new enemy)

[*] Creatures that shoot arrows can roll to evade
[*] Creatures that have a shield can block to defend
[*] Explosive Barrels added to Camps
[*] Storm Armor Set to Craft and Equip
[*] NPC Merchants featured in the World
[*] New Materials from NPC Merchants
[*] New Camps and Landmarks featured in the Desert
[*] New Camps and Landmarks featured in the Land of Pools
[*] Earn collaborative XP by defeating Giants

[*] Biome Level depends on distance and on elevations of the World
[/list]
[b]
Quality of Life[/b]

[*] Disable/Enable HUD and UI in-game via Settings

[*] 5 Languages added to the Game: Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch, Ukranian & Russian 
[/list]

Several balance changes to adjust the difficulty and the content.

[*] Loot is more spread out between all Creatures
[*] Giant Armor decreased significantly
[*] Giant Multiplier scales differently along Difficulty
[*] Creatures can damage Giants with their Spells
[*] Ymir Eyelash Tree of Life can heal Closed/Opened Gates
[*] Some Treasure Chests contain a random Equipment
[/list]
[h1]
BUG FIXES[/h1]

Several issues signaled by the team and especially the community that are currently [b]FIXED[/b].

[b]Main Fixed Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Night Shader sometimes not visually displaying when it’s Night
[*] Equipped Weapon randomly unequipping while playing with a Controller
[*] Menu Navigation not stable with Controller 
[*] Loot/Treasure Chests landing on top of unreachable Cliffs or Decor
[*] Winter Effect unavailable after a game crash and returning to game after
[*] Dying on a Ramp preventing Death Treasure Chest from appearing
[*] Dropping too many Items crashing the game
[*] HP Bars of other Players not synchronising
[*] Players exceeding the amount of Player Slots in-game
[*] Giant being stuck on their way to Village
[*] Gates not appearing after being built
[/list]
[b]
Small Fixed Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Player receiving XP after receiving the Game Over Screen
[*] Player could have level locked cosmetics already equipped
[*] Giant sometimes walking in T-Pose
[*] Players being in ragdoll and not being seen by some Players
[*] Colliders not fitting the decor or modules in the World
[*] Enabling Display Names didn’t show the names of Player Avatars in-game
[/list]

[b]Issues That Remain:[/b]
[list]
[*] Possible game crash which requires all Players to disconnect and reconnect to the game after
[*] Possible minor visual glitches while interacting with the Community Chest
[*] Possible menu glitches while interacting with the Fortifications for some Players which requires only a game reconnection from that player
[*] Snow not appearing sometimes in game which requires to wait on the next days for it to appear again
[*] Player Avatar losing running animations which requires Player to attack again
[*] Player Names floating which requires only to wait a few seconds for it to disappear
[/list]

[h1]MORE INFORMATION[/h1]
Be sure to take a look on our Road Map via this link:

https://www.tribesofmidgard.com/news/

We have a Wiki page! It's community-made, so feel free to use this as a guide and to add to it while playing:

https://tribesofmidgard.gamepedia.com/Tribes_of_Midgard_Wiki

You can stream and record gameplay as you want. We are excited to see more footage and highlights from this Beta!

[h1]BETA CHALLENGES[/h1]
We're holding [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/tribesofmidgard]Beta challenges in our Discord[/url]! If you complete any of the new or old challenges, you'll earn these exclusive Beta cosmetics for the future: The Unsunken Javelin Viking hair cut and Goblin player portrait:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/ab45072b161e332141a5cfbe5c9156114b6351b7.jpg[/img]

[h1]TO HELP US[/h1]
If you have any issues or bugs while playing the game, be sure to report it via our Discord #beta-bugs channel. You can also talk with us, give us any feedback, and find a team in the #find-players channel! Join here: 

[url= https://discordapp.com/invite/tribesofmidgard][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/7c2338a68ee929a458cc0955528ad76c8418a7cf.png[/img][/url]

Lastly, if you're enjoying the game, make sure to Wishlist it on our main Steam page!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/858820/Tribes_of_Midgard/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/4ff59dd2a71fa0e1cf6dc049d33323558219e263.jpg[/img][/url]

Head forth once again, and from all of us, best of luck in surviving the Giants! 

See you in Midgard,

Sydnee, JP, and the Norsfell Team ❄️

notes.title: Play the Last Open Beta Tomorrow, December 11th-15th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/fa507eb9a112c528de7c4b81e32fc6bbe8eb2e55.jpg[/img]

notes.title: November Monthly Recap
notes.content:
Hey Vikings! 

Starting this month, we'll be releasing monthly recaps to keep you in the loop on everything we're up to, whether it be Tribes of Midgard related or our favourite community posts this month!
[b]In this November recap, we'll share these highlights of the month:[/b]
[list]
[*] Big News (three nominations for awards)!
[*] Open Beta 3 News
[*] Event Recap
[*] Community Highlights
[*] A hint at the end...[/list]
Check all of it out below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/0815e107f44219eec5249dcae943ef0fd9c50de5.jpg[/img][h1]We were nominated for 3 awards at MEGA + MIGS![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/4411accb2f8bade83ba21aa57dec372aa40abcf3.jpg[/img]
We're incredibly honored to have been nominated for THREE awards at MEGA + MIGS last weekend:

⚔️ Gameplay Design
💙 Public’s Favourite
🎨 and Art Direction!

Thanks so much to everyone who had a chance to play the game!

Without getting too cheesy, being nominated for these categories means the absolute world to us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/85237c4a34c951f25f8aaf15ed963950ff3757ba.jpg[/img]

[h1]Quick Development Update![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/231478631397362704107d10e5958a634a484815.gif[/img]

As you know, you'll be able to battle Giants again and play [b]Tribes of Midgard in Early December[/b], for Open Beta 3!

We're finally on our last stretch to lock the current build for the Open Beta 3. From there, we’ll take time to test it and start working on features for the next build. So far we've announced two new enemies: the Helthing Boss and Unsunken Javelin! But there's more on the way, so prepare for a fight. 

Midgard's getting dangerous! 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/05623d5cbf1976a723471d0198624334ab925a6b.png[/img]

We're also adding new Camps to find in the world, to make the Land of Pools feel even swampier. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/ab11aa3e8edaa3526cefda5291a4b8027ffe9150.png[/img]

We finished the community chest, and it's ready for you to share all your loot! Check it out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/fe7a233020ee0644098cec5ffec1c02156d2edea.gif[/img]

We're in the process of making an Open Beta 3 trailer, so we've been doing a lot of new gameplay recording and can't wait to share it with you!

We're also excited to say that we've already started working on some future features (the ones coming after this Open Beta) - such as Giant #3, and designing the Construction system! We're also researching features like player ping and map markers, to enhance communication between teammates. Onwards!

[h1]Make sure to check out Tribes of Midgard on Steam![/h1]
This is our main Steam page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/858820/Tribes_of_Midgard/

Make sure to follow us there so you can be notified when the game is open. We post important updates like the latest localization news,  upcoming features, and will announce the Open Beta dates there first!

While you're there, it would mean a lot to us if you Wishlisted the game! 💙

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/0a07e84255f1484625f58800b6a2157835f846fb.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/3744c2c3a144624dca3c819813ce94b8a5a99da4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Join the Wiki Team on Discord![/h1]
[url=discordapp.com/invite/tribesofmidgard][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/ee27962b6258b7875195c50855141c548f82b850.png[/img][/url]

We have a Tribes of Midgard Wiki, which can be your ultimate guide during Open Beta 3. However, it's still in the process of being made by our amazing Wiki Team. So, if you want to help fill it out, and want to get a document full of Tribes knowledge, join the Wiki Team! 

[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/tribesofmidgard]PM Any of our Moderators on Discord to join![/url]

Visit the Wiki here:

https://tribesofmidgard.gamepedia.com/Tribes_of_Midgard_Wiki

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/1d90e737bc1bda7a3c9132dd5c480306cf09d0cc.png[/img]

[h1]The Discord Localization Team 🌎[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/b48e00f595d6382a651cc357a709cc074f181a29.png[/img]

We're extremely proud of our translation team on Discord. Having Tribes of Midgard available in different languages has always been a goal of ours, and it's now happening thanks to you! Check it out, the game's now been translated into [b]8 different languages[/b].

You can help in translating the game, just head to our Discord and PM JiPay!
 
[h1]Become the Quiz Jarl of the week (you know you want to...)![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/874a8a625a1b277941b0d5c38a16ca0a0f55ef39.png[/img]

Every Thursday, we're running Tribes of Midgard quizzes [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/tribesofmidgard]in the Discord[/url] in the #play-quiz channel. The quizzes are:
[list]
[*] 15 questions long
[*] 20 seconds per question
[*] With 1 winner, who becomes the Quiz Jarl of the week!
[/list]
When the month is done, the person with the highest score keeps the Quiz Jarl of the month title. We keep track of everyone's scores! Come test your knowledge, and see if you can take over the reign (Plus, learn a little bit about Norse Mythology)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/b510f50bdbb855f348bf66ee9a2588f9649de691.jpg[/img]

[h1]We went to MEGA + MIGS![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/a78c36c68cd1af8fb7f505968fa8e7bddf30db82.png[/img]

Last weekend we attended MEGA + MIGS, and as you saw, came back with 3 nominations for awards! Thanks so much to everyone who came out to see us, and for playing some Tribes of Midgard! 😄 

It was an absolute blast- over the 4 convention days we met many awesome people, and got the chance to try out some sweet games ourselves. For those who just signed up to the newsletter while there - welcome! Glad to have you as part of our Tribe!

[h1]Birthdays at Norsfell 🎂
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/b8f06ec5a7308de1f0f58e31d08ad3c5a1abee68.png[/img]

This month we wished Mari, our illustrator, and Richard, our game designer, a happy birthday! Our tradition involves watching them eat a tiny cake.

[h1]Norsfell Turned 6 Years Old![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/79a3b00ee2e9710adbb05605b610a0817813c735.jpg[/img]
Did you know? Norsfell just turned SIX years old! 🎉 We're grateful that you're here joining us along our development journey. We're proud of what we've accomplished these past years, and can't wait to see where the next six take us. 😃

That's it! November was a busy month, and you're all caught up on the latest news. 

Expecting an easter egg? Well... let's just say, [url=https://twitter.com/tribesofmidgard]keep an eye out on our Twitter[/url] this Thursday. We might be doing a little giveaway...

Until next time,

Sydnee, JP, and the Norsfell Team 🗻

notes.title: Play the Open Beta!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35462321/adde181fede64f5685335dab8d30b61aca5ebf72.jpg[/img]

Hey Vikings,

The Beta for Tribes of Midgard is now OPEN! Raise your swords and gather your Tribe. Make sure to head to our BETA Steam page to play, as this is our Early Access page.[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1106880/Tribes_of_Midgard__Open_Beta/]Play the Beta here[/url]


[u][b]A few reminders before you enter Midgard:[/b][/u]

Our servers are open right now until Sunday, July 28th, at 11:59pm ET
There is no NDA to be signed: stream and share all you’d like!

[u][b]And a few game-related notes:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] [u]Keyboards: [/u]For now, the game supports only QWERTY keyboards. If you're using another keyboard, you can change it to QWERTY mode from the Region and Language settings in Windows, or use a controller.
[*] [u]Day/Night transitions:[/u] May become rapid if the game experiences lag
[*] [u]Possible crash:[/u] when leaving a world and joining another without exiting the game, crash may occur
[*] [u]Visuals: [/u]Creatures may appear suddenly when a piece of the world is loaded
[/list]

[u][b]Performance Note:[/b][/u]

Tribes can support up to 10 players in one village, however this may affect game performance. For anyone streaming the game, we suggest limiting the amount of players to 6 when creating a game. This can be changed in the "Max Players Amount" setting in the Create Game screen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35462321/1d9d3369043a88e11ea69c39027c4e292e3a6ab4.jpg[/img]

[url=http://discord.gg/tribesofmidgard]Come Join our Discord[/url] to chat about the game, give your feedback, and report any issues you run into. We’re always hanging around there!

See you in Midgard!
The Norsfell Team
